title: Voyager Launches Open AI Harness for 100+ Creative Tools
summary:
Professional software like Blender and After Effects can now be controlled by generative AI models via a new platform called Voyager. The system operates as an open harness that connects models including Opus, Astra and DeepSeek to over 100 creative tools, which the developers describe as the equivalent of Codex for creative work. It includes its own set of free graphics, music and video editing utilities alongside the ability to automate workflows across external applications.

The tool targets the production of high-end video, graphics and games, moving away from the coding-centric focus of most AI utilities. It reflects a broader shift in the AI economy toward software that acts as an orchestration layer, selecting the most effective model and tool to complete a specific creative task.
